title: Italia Dance Music Radio - You Will Come Back

lines.l: The echoes linger in the night
Your name still burns in pale moonlight
The stars, they whisper what will be
They promise you'll come back to me
You will come back, I know it's true
The sky will turn from grey to blue
The winds will carry your heart's plea
You'll find your way back home to me
The clock, it ticks, but time's a lie
It can't erase what's you and I
I hold the moments close, you see
They prove you'll come back to me
The world can spin and oceans part
But I will wait with open heart
No force can break what's meant to be
You're bound to come back home to me
You will come back, I know it's true
The sky will turn from grey to blue
The winds will carry your heart's plea
You'll find your way back home to me
I love you, Italy, dance music, pure energy, pure joy.
